name: Street Rod gas station
description: Street Rod's gas station: Crossroads Gas, its forecourt, pumps and office by the road at the edge of town, other cars parked there each day, the attendant at the pump in his uniform and cap, and its sounds (the bell, the pump, the air).
credits: "Speaking Man with Talking Gestures" by LasquetiSpice, CC BY 4.0, https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/speaking-man-with-talking-gestures-c55bcf894e1b4da1adf0cf258fe94c9f; dressed as a 1950s service man (his clothes repainted, a peaked cap and a bow tie added)
